name: dashboard
description: Customizable dashboard to monitor digital content.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:lighthouse: npm run build -w shared && VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4174 npm run build -w frontend -- --outDir dist-lighthouse
scripts.lighthouse: npm run build:lighthouse && npm run lighthouse -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:generate -w backend && npm test -w shared -w backend -w frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:generate -w backend && npm test -w e2e
